<documents>
<document id="disputes-provisional-credit">
ProvisionalˆcreditˆduringˆaˆdisputeˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆputˆbackˆinˆyourˆaccountˆwhileˆweˆinvestigateˆaˆdispute.ˆItˆletsˆyouˆuseˆtheˆmoneyˆwithoutˆwaitingˆforˆtheˆfinalˆoutcome.ˆ##ˆWhenˆyouˆgetˆitˆIfˆyourˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆarrivesˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆofˆfiling.ˆItˆshowsˆinˆyourˆactivityˆasˆ"Provisionalˆcredit"ˆwithˆtheˆmerchantˆname.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆtheˆinvestigationˆtakesˆMostˆdisputesˆareˆresolvedˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆForˆforeignˆtransactions,ˆandˆforˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆitˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆgoesˆyourˆwayˆTheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆbecomesˆpermanent.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆWeˆsendˆyouˆaˆwrittenˆexplanationˆandˆtakeˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆthatˆnotice.ˆIfˆthatˆmakesˆyourˆbalanceˆnegative,ˆyou'llˆneedˆtoˆaddˆmoney.ˆNotˆeveryˆdisputeˆgetsˆaˆprovisionalˆcredit.ˆForˆexample,ˆweˆmayˆwaitˆforˆtheˆmerchant'sˆresponseˆifˆyouˆalreadyˆreceivedˆaˆrefundˆforˆpartˆofˆtheˆpurchase.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-how-to-file">
HowˆtoˆfileˆaˆdisputeˆMostˆdisputesˆcanˆbeˆfiledˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfileˆoneˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆFileˆitˆyourselfˆ1.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed.ˆ2.ˆTapˆGetˆhelpˆandˆchooseˆtheˆreason.ˆ3.ˆAnswerˆtheˆquestionsˆandˆaddˆanyˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆfileˆ-ˆTheˆtransactionˆmustˆhaveˆposted.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ-ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactions:ˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆdate,ˆandˆtheˆcardˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆfirst.ˆ-ˆMerchantˆproblems:ˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate,ˆafterˆcontactingˆtheˆmerchant.ˆ##ˆFilingˆthroughˆsupportˆSupportˆcanˆopenˆdisputesˆtotalingˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆperˆcase.ˆLargerˆcasesˆgoˆtoˆourˆDisputesˆteam,ˆwhoˆwillˆcontactˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆOneˆdisputeˆperˆtransactionˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆalreadyˆhasˆanˆopenˆdispute,ˆaddˆinformationˆtoˆthatˆcaseˆinsteadˆofˆopeningˆaˆnewˆone.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="cushion-negative-after-dispute">
NegativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆYourˆbalanceˆcanˆgoˆnegativeˆwhenˆweˆtakeˆbackˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned.ˆThisˆisn'tˆCushion,ˆandˆitˆcanˆhappenˆonˆanyˆplan,ˆincludingˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆlendˆyouˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆinvestigated.ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆweˆgiveˆyouˆwrittenˆnoticeˆandˆtakeˆitˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater.ˆIfˆyou'veˆspentˆitˆinˆtheˆmeantime,ˆtheˆbalanceˆcanˆdropˆbelowˆzero.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆyourˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆincomingˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆ##ˆFeesˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆforˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆisn'tˆrepaidˆAsˆwithˆCushion,ˆifˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆlastsˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆOnˆPlusˆandˆPremium,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆwhileˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆnegativeˆforˆlongerˆthanˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCan'tˆpayˆitˆrightˆaway?ˆMessageˆsupport.ˆIfˆyou'reˆgoingˆthroughˆfinancialˆhardship,ˆweˆcanˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
